prompt: Title-case a sentence. Complete the capitalizeWords method so every word starts with an uppercase letter followed by lowercase letters, joined by single spaces regardless of the input's spacing.
explanation: Trimming first, then splitting on the regex \s+ (one or more whitespace characters), turns any messy spacing into a clean array of words with no empty entries. Each word is rebuilt from Character.toUpperCase on its first character plus toLowerCase on the substring from index 1, which also fixes ALL-CAPS input. A StringBuilder joins the words back together, inserting a space before every word except the first.
hints: trim() the input first; if the trimmed string is empty, return "" right away.
split("\\s+") breaks the string on runs of whitespace so double spaces do not create empty words.
Rebuild each word as Character.toUpperCase(word.charAt(0)) + word.substring(1).toLowerCase().
